variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the single htimg operator account. Choose the value the operator will enter on the login screen.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the single htimg operator account. Set this to a strong secret before using the app outside local development.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Secret used to sign htimg session cookies. Generate a long random value and keep it private.
